That evening he lit a second lamp in the window and composed a long reply, sealing it in the same bottle, trusting the tide to carry it home.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市睡得很沉。街灯把空荡的马路照成一条淡黄的河，偶尔有出租车驶过，带起一阵短促的风。早点铺的卷帘门半开，蒸汽从缝里钻出来，和清冷的空气缠在一起。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。天边已经泛起一层薄薄的青灰，楼宇的轮廓渐渐清晰。鸟还没醒，世界安静得像被按下了暂停键，只等第一缕阳光，把这座城市重新唤醒。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by calling a smaller copy of itself, like looking into two mirrors facing each other.\n• Each copy handles a tinier piece, until the piece is so small the answer is obvious and no more copies are needed.\n• Then all the little answers stack back together to solve the big problem you started with."}
